cooking_instructions: Roast sweet potato wedges at 210 C until golden, approximately 18-20 minutes, turning halfway. Chop cucumber and mix with yoghurt and lemon to make a simple tzatziki-style salad. Warm the flatbreads briefly, then fill with halloumi and cucumber yoghurt. Serve with the sweet potato wedges.
